---
title: "Comparing TPS, IDW, OK, and UK"
description: "Compare deterministic and geostatistical surfaces, diagnostics, assumptions, and validation results."
output: rmarkdown::html_vignette
---

TPS, IDW, ordinary kriging, and universal kriging encode different assumptions.
Request them explicitly and inspect method conditions, support, residuals, and
fit objects. `ps_compare_methods()` ranks only within one validation design,
support subset, and objective. It does not identify a universally best method,
and a requested method is never silently replaced.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
v <- ps_validate(points, c("TPS","IDW","OK","UK"), "spatial_block", folds=5)
ps_compare_methods(v, metric="rmse", support_subset="supported")
```
